description: This file contains unit tests for the ModelTrait used in serializers, focusing on model attributes, filtering, nested array construction, and entity-model conversions within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: ModelTraitTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing features of ModelTrait such as attribute selection, filtering, nested array creation, and entity to model conversion.

classes.name: TestJobTitleEntity
classes.description: Mock entity representing a Job Title with get/set methods for name and description.

classes.name: TestEmployeeEntity
classes.description: Mock entity representing an Employee with ID and job title, including get/set methods.

classes.name: TestJobTitleModel
classes.description: A normalizable model class using ModelTrait, wrapping TestJobTitleEntity.

classes.name: TestEmployeeModel
classes.description: A normalizable model class using ModelTrait, wrapping TestEmployeeEntity.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A generic class using ModelTrait, primarily for testing the private method makeNestedArray.

methods.name: testSetEntity
methods.description: Tests initializing the model with an entity and converting it to an array with minimal attributes.

methods.name: testSetFilters
methods.description: Tests setting filters on the model and verifying array output with filtered attributes.

methods.name: testSetAttributeNames
methods.description: Tests replacing attribute names and verifying the array reflects the attribute renaming.

methods.name: testToArrayWithChaining
methods.description: Tests complex scenarios of nested entities, setting attribute names, and filters with chained method calls, verifying the final array structure.

methods.name: testMakeNestedArray
methods.description: Tests the private method makeNestedArray with various key paths and values, ensuring correct nested array construction.
